Staff.title: Staff
Staff.description: Represents a staff member, combining profile, auth, and app-specific data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Staff entity, typically the Firebase Auth UID.

name.description: The name of the staff member.

email.description: The staff member's email address, used for login.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

color.description: A color code (e.g., HSL) for display in the UI.

role.description: The user's role in the application.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user profile was created.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a customer with their contact and location details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Customer entity.

latitude.description: The latitude of the customer's location.

longitude.description: The longitude of the customer's location.

Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.description: Represents a work schedule entry, linking staff, customer, and time.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Schedule entity.

startTime.description: The start time of the schedule.

endTime.description: The end time of the schedule.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Represents a work location with geographical coordinates.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Location entity.

EmployeeAction.title: EmployeeAction
EmployeeAction.description: Represents an action performed by an employee during their workday.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EmployeeAction entity.

actionType.description: The type of action performed (e.g., Arrive, Begin Task, Finish Task, Depart).

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the action was performed.

AdminConfig.title: AdminConfig
AdminConfig.description: Configuration document for storing admin user UIDs.

admin_uids.description: An array of Firebase Authentication UIDs for users who have admin privileges.

/staff/{staffId}.description: Stores staff member profiles. Only admins can manage this data.

/customers/{customerId}.description: Stores customer profiles. Only admins can manage this data.

/schedules/{scheduleId}.description: Stores work schedules. Only admins can manage this data.

/locations/{locationId}_.description: Stores location data. Only admins can manage this data.

/staff/{staffId}/employee_actions/{emplo.description: Stores employee actions. Staff can manage their own actions, and admins can manage any.

/config/admins.description: A single document that stores a list of admin UIDs. This is used by security rules to grant admin privileges.
